doc: Seeded, PLATFORM-OWNED render-time helpers. DO NOT EDIT.

params.name: name
params.doc: DNS-label step name: the Argo template, the steps/<dir> folder and the image-<step> parameter.

params.name: reads
params.doc: Config sections (top-level keys of the config/ tree) the step reads; checked at render.

params.name: gpu
params.doc: The step needs one GPU; only GPU steps run on the HPC target.

params.name: needs
params.doc: Steps this one depends on; their declared outputs become inputs of this step.

params.name: outputs
params.doc: Names of small result files the step writes to /work/output/<name>.json.

params.name: when
params.doc: An Argo `when` expression; the step is skipped when it is false.

params.name: disk
params.doc: Ephemeral-storage request as a Kubernetes quantity, e.g. '20Gi'.

params.name: hpc_time_limit
params.doc: Slurm wall-clock limit of a gpu=True step on the HPC target: '90m', '12h' or '720' (minutes).

params.name: resumable
params.doc: gpu=True only. True or a lead time ('20m', '1h'): how long before the HPC wall time the step is told to save its checkpoint; False opts out.

params.name: checkpoint_every
params.doc: How often the platform copies the step's checkpoint folder: minutes ('20m', '1h', 20); False = no copies; unset = the platform default.

params.name: idle_timeout
params.doc: How long a step may show no GPU use and no new log line before it is ended as Idle: minutes ('40m', '1h', 40); 0 or False = never; unset = the platform rule.
